notes: Game-specific actions on top of the generic tools. Kinds: 'lua' (code run via lua_run in the UE4SS hook state) or 'calls' (steps of {tool, params}). {{name}} substitutes recipe args. Entries marked TODO still need the real function/property names confirmed in game.

time_of_day.description: Set Ultra Dynamic Sky time of day (0..2400).
time_of_day.code: local sky = FindFirstOf('Ultra_Dynamic_Sky_C'); if not sky or not sky:IsValid() then return 'no UDS actor' end; sky['Time of Day'] = {{time}}; return sky['Time of Day']

give_item.description: Spawn a JigSInventory pickup of class {{class}} in front of the player and run its F-interact path (OnBeginInteract + OnExecuteInteract), which equips or stores it. Verified in game: equips into a free slot, otherwise stores; ammo and magazines land in the pockets a moment later.
give_item.code: local pc, pawn = UE5MCP.player(); if not pawn then return 'no pawn' end; local cls = StaticFindObject('{{class}}'); if not cls or not cls:IsValid() then local a, found = LoadAsset('{{class}}'); cls = a end; if not cls or not cls:IsValid() then return 'class not loadable: {{class}}' end; local loc = pawn:K2_GetActorLocation(); local fwd = pawn:GetActorForwardVector(); local world = pawn:GetWorld(); if not world:IsValid() then return 'no world' end; local actor = world:SpawnActor(cls, {X = loc.X + fwd.X * {{distance}}, Y = loc.Y + fwd.Y * {{distance}}, Z = loc.Z}, {Pitch = 0, Yaw = 0, Roll = 0}); if not actor or not actor:IsValid() then return 'spawn failed' end; pcall(function() actor:OnBeginInteract(pawn, {}) end); pcall(function() actor:OnExecuteInteract(pawn, 0) end); return actor:GetFullName()
